+//! The shell's one command table (#4484): each fixed command's id, label,
+//! ribbon group, menu group and shortcut, read by the ribbon, the menu bar
+//! and the keyboard layer alike; our own design notes (desktop menu-bar
+//! convention), no third-party text.
+
+use egui::{InputState, Key};
+
+use crate::shortcut_keys::chord;
+
+use super::cmd::Cmd;
+
+/// The ribbon's anchor group captions. The Create groups between them come
+/// from the operation registry (`ribbon_plan`), not from this table.
+pub(in crate::egui_app) const FILE: &str = "File";
+pub(in crate::egui_app) const SETUP: &str = "Setup";
+pub(in crate::egui_app) const MODIFY: &str = "Modify";
+pub(in crate::egui_app) const INSPECT: &str = "Inspect";
+pub(in crate::egui_app) const VIEW: &str = "View";
+
+/// The menu bar's top-level menus, in bar order.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub(in crate::egui_app) enum Menu {
+    File,
+    Edit,
+    Setup,
+    /// The operation kinds, one submenu for each catalog section, and Run.
+    Operation,
+    Inspect,
+    View,
+}
+
+impl Menu {
+    pub(in crate::egui_app) const ALL: [Menu; 6] =
+        [Menu::File, Menu::Edit, Menu::Setup, Menu::Operation, Menu::Inspect, Menu::View];
+
+    pub(in crate::egui_app) const fn title(self) -> &'static str {
+        match self {
+            Menu::File => "File",
+            Menu::Edit => "Edit",
+            Menu::Setup => "Setup",
+            Menu::Operation => "Operation",
+            Menu::Inspect => "Inspect",
+            Menu::View => "View",
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// One keyboard shortcut. `None` in a modifier slot means "either state";
+/// `typing` lets the key fire while a text field has focus (only the
+/// history keys do, the imgui `WantTextInput` law).
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub(in crate::egui_app) struct Shortcut {
+    pub key: Key,
+    pub command: Option<bool>,
+    pub shift: Option<bool>,
+    pub alt: Option<bool>,
+    pub typing: bool,
+    /// The hint after the command key (`chord`), or the whole hint for a
+    /// key without the command modifier.
+    pub text: &'static str,
+}
+
+const fn slot(want: Option<bool>, have: bool) -> bool {
+    match want {
+        Some(w) => w == have,
+        None => true,
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+const fn meet(a: Option<bool>, b: Option<bool>) -> bool {
+    match (a, b) {
+        (Some(x), Some(y)) => x == y,
+        _ => true,
+    }
+}
+
+impl Shortcut {
+    /// The key in this frame's input, with its modifiers and focus rule.
+    pub(in crate::egui_app) fn fires(&self, i: &InputState, typing: bool) -> bool {
+        i.key_pressed(self.key)
+            && (self.typing || !typing)
+            && slot(self.command, i.modifiers.command)
+            && slot(self.shift, i.modifiers.shift)
+            && slot(self.alt, i.modifiers.alt)
+    }
+
+    /// Can one key press fire both shortcuts? The duplicate test's word.
+    #[cfg(test)]
+    pub(in crate::egui_app) fn overlaps(&self, other: &Shortcut) -> bool {
+        self.key == other.key
+            && meet(self.command, other.command)
+            && meet(self.shift, other.shift)
+            && meet(self.alt, other.alt)
+    }
+
+    /// The platform hint: `Cmd+S` on macOS, `Ctrl+S` elsewhere, `Del`.
+    pub(in crate::egui_app) fn hint(&self) -> String {
+        if self.command == Some(true) { chord(self.text) } else { self.text.to_owned() }
+    }
+}
+
+/// One command of the shell.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
+pub(in crate::egui_app) struct Row {
+    pub cmd: Cmd,
+    /// Stable id (tests, a later command search).
+    #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]
+    pub id: &'static str,
+    pub label: &'static str,
+    /// The ribbon anchor group that shows the command, if any.
+    pub ribbon: Option<&'static str>,
+    /// The menu that lists the command, if any.
+    pub menu: Option<Menu>,
+    pub key: Option<Shortcut>,
+}
+
+const fn ctrl(key: Key, shift: Option<bool>, text: &'static str) -> Option<Shortcut> {
+    Some(Shortcut { key, command: Some(true), shift, alt: None, typing: false, text })
+}
+
+const fn bare(key: Key, text: &'static str) -> Option<Shortcut> {
+    Some(Shortcut { key, command: Some(false), shift: None, alt: Some(false), typing: false, text })
+}
+
+const fn row(
+    cmd: Cmd,
+    id: &'static str,
+    label: &'static str,
+    ribbon: Option<&'static str>,
+    menu: Option<Menu>,
+    key: Option<Shortcut>,
+) -> Row {
+    Row { cmd, id, label, ribbon, menu, key }
+}
+
+/// The table. Row order is ribbon order inside a group and menu order
+/// inside a menu. `Cmd::Create` and `Cmd::More` are the registry's
+/// (`camcraft_app::operation`), so they have no row here.
+pub(in crate::egui_app) const TABLE: &[Row] = &[
+    row(Cmd::New, "file.new", "New", Some(FILE), Some(Menu::File), ctrl(Key::N, None, "N")),
+    row(Cmd::Model, "file.model", "Model", Some(FILE), Some(Menu::File), ctrl(Key::O, Some(false), "O")),
+    row(Cmd::Project, "file.project", "Open", Some(FILE), Some(Menu::File), ctrl(Key::O, Some(true), "Shift+O")),
+    row(Cmd::Save, "file.save", "Save", Some(FILE), Some(Menu::File), ctrl(Key::S, Some(false), "S")),
+    row(Cmd::SaveAs, "file.save_as", "Save As", Some(FILE), Some(Menu::File), ctrl(Key::S, Some(true), "Shift+S")),
+    row(Cmd::Post, "file.post", "Post", Some(FILE), Some(Menu::File), ctrl(Key::P, None, "P")),
+    // #4493: the top band's Settings button is its ribbon entry.
+    row(Cmd::Settings, "file.settings", "Settings…", None, Some(Menu::File), None),
+    row(Cmd::Quit, "file.quit", "Quit", None, Some(Menu::File), ctrl(Key::Q, None, "Q")),
+    row(Cmd::Setups, "setup.setups", "Setups", Some(SETUP), Some(Menu::Setup), None),
+    row(Cmd::Stock, "setup.stock", "Stock", Some(SETUP), Some(Menu::Setup), None),
+    row(Cmd::Origin, "setup.origin", "Origin", Some(SETUP), Some(Menu::Setup), None),
+    row(Cmd::Tools, "setup.tools", "Tools", Some(SETUP), Some(Menu::Setup), None),
+    // The workspace tabs carry the machine switch; the row keeps its label.
+    row(Cmd::Machine, "setup.machine", "Machine", None, None, None),
+    // Undo and redo fire while typing too (the history keys).
+    row(
+        Cmd::Undo,
+        "edit.undo",
+        "Undo",
+        Some(MODIFY),
+        Some(Menu::Edit),
+        Some(Shortcut { key: Key::Z, command: Some(true), shift: Some(false), alt: Some(false), typing: true, text: "Z" }),
+    ),
+    // Ctrl+Y and Ctrl+Shift+Y both redo (imgui law).
+    row(
+        Cmd::Redo,
+        "edit.redo",
+        "Redo",
+        Some(MODIFY),
+        Some(Menu::Edit),
+        Some(Shortcut { key: Key::Y, command: Some(true), shift: None, alt: None, typing: true, text: "Y" }),
+    ),
+    row(Cmd::Run, "operation.run", "Run", Some(MODIFY), Some(Menu::Operation), None),
+    row(Cmd::Copy, "edit.copy", "Copy", None, Some(Menu::Edit), ctrl(Key::C, None, "C")),
+    row(Cmd::Paste, "edit.paste", "Paste", None, Some(Menu::Edit), ctrl(Key::V, None, "V")),
+    row(
+        Cmd::Delete,
+        "edit.delete",
+        "Delete",
+        Some(MODIFY),
+        Some(Menu::Edit),
+        Some(Shortcut { key: Key::Delete, command: None, shift: None, alt: None, typing: false, text: "Del" }),
+    ),
+    row(Cmd::Frame, "inspect.frame", "Frame", Some(INSPECT), Some(Menu::Inspect), bare(Key::F, "F")),
+    row(Cmd::Paths, "inspect.paths", "Paths", Some(INSPECT), Some(Menu::Inspect), None),
+    row(Cmd::Simulate, "inspect.simulate", "Simulate", Some(INSPECT), Some(Menu::Inspect), None),
+    row(Cmd::Deviate, "inspect.deviate", "Deviate", Some(INSPECT), Some(Menu::Inspect), None),
+    row(Cmd::View, "view.panels", "Panels", Some(VIEW), Some(Menu::View), None),
+    row(Cmd::Theme, "view.theme", "Theme", Some(VIEW), Some(Menu::View), None),
+    // #434: bare P flips perspective/ortho (Ctrl+P is the post lane).
+    row(Cmd::Projection, "view.projection", "Toggle projection", None, Some(Menu::View), bare(Key::P, "P")),
+];
+
+/// The table row of a fixed command; `None` for the registry's commands.
+pub(in crate::egui_app) fn row_of(c: Cmd) -> Option<&'static Row> {
+    TABLE.iter().find(|r| r.cmd == c)
+}
+
+/// The commands of one ribbon anchor group, in table order.
+pub(in crate::egui_app) fn ribbon_group(title: &str) -> Vec<Cmd> {
+    TABLE.iter().filter(|r| r.ribbon == Some(title)).map(|r| r.cmd).collect()
+}
+
+/// The shortcut hint of a command, if it has a key.
+pub(in crate::egui_app) fn key_hint(c: Cmd) -> Option<String> {
+    row_of(c).and_then(|r| r.key).map(|k| k.hint())
+}
+
+/// A stable id for any command, the registry's included.
+#[cfg(test)]
+pub(in crate::egui_app) fn id_of(c: Cmd) -> String {
+    match c {
+        Cmd::Create(i) => match camcraft_app::operation::KindInfo::ALL.get(i) {
+            Some(k) => format!("operation.create.{}", k.label),
+            None => format!("operation.create.{i}"),
+        },
+        Cmd::More(s) => format!("operation.section.{}", s.label()),
+        other => row_of(other).map_or_else(|| format!("{other:?}"), |r| r.id.to_owned()),
+    }
+}

+## #4484 - One command table and an in-app menu bar
+
+**Decided.**
+
+- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes/table.rs` is the one command table. Each
+  fixed command has one row: id, label, ribbon group, menu and shortcut.
+  The ribbon's anchor groups (File, Setup, Modify, Inspect, View), the
+  menu bar and the keyboard layer all read it. The hover text, the enabled
+  rule and the icon stay functions of `Cmd` in `cmd.rs` and `gates.rs`,
+  because they read the document state each frame.
+- The operation kinds and the section doors are not table rows. They come
+  from the operation registry (`camcraft_app::operation`), as before. The
+  menu bar's Operation menu has one submenu for each section that the
+  machine can run, with every kind of that section (pinned kinds too).
+- The menus are File, Edit, Setup, Operation, Inspect and View. They
+  follow the ribbon groups; Edit holds the history and clipboard rows.
+  There is no Help menu: no command of the shell belongs there yet.
+- Four commands that had only a key now have a `Cmd` and a menu row:
+  Copy, Paste, Quit and Toggle projection. They are not on the ribbon.
+  So the menu lists the ribbon's ids plus these four, and the test checks
+  exactly that.
+- A menu row and a key press use `run_direct`: the ribbon's `run_cmd`,
+  except that Model and Open go straight to their file dialogs (the keys
+  did this before). The ribbon's recent-files lists hang under their own
+  cells, so the menu does not open them.
+- A disabled menu row says why on hover. `disabled_reason` adds short
+  reasons for the gates that had none (Undo, Redo, Run, Copy, Paste,
+  Delete, Simulate, Deviate). The Create rows keep their refusal tips. The
+  ribbon tips do not change.
+- The menu bar is a top panel over the ribbon, `menu_bar_h` high (one
+  control row). The ribbon itself is unchanged; it moves down by that
+  height.
+- The top-level menu buttons have the AccessKit name "<title> menu"
+  ("View menu"). The visible titles share words with other buttons (the
+  browser's View door, the tool page's Edit), and the name keeps each
+  label unique for screen readers and tests.
+
+**Dropped.**
+
+- A native macOS menu bar: it needs a new dependency (maintainer decision,
+  #4245 follow-up).
+- Labels, tips and icons as table columns: they depend on the state, so a
+  column would hold a closure for each row and save nothing.
+- Help and Tools menus with no commands in them.
+
+**Cost to change later.** A new fixed command is one table row plus its
+arms in `tip_of`, `enabled`, `icon_of` and `run_cmd` (the compiler names
+each). A menu move is one field of the row.

+## #4493 - The Settings window (Appearance, Graphics, Graphics device, Updates)
+
+**Decided.**
+
+- The window is an in-app `egui::Window` (`settings_window.rs`), the same
+  law as the tool shape window. A section list at the left, the rows of
+  the chosen section at the right. Only one section shows at a time, so
+  each row label stays unique for screen readers and tests.
+- The ribbon top band's Settings button opens and closes the window. The
+  one-row dropdown is gone. The window opening is view state
+  (`State::settings_open`), not a command, as the doors are.
+- The menu bar row is `file.settings`, "Settings…", in the File menu above
+  Quit. The decision file of #4484 has no Help or Tools menu, and File is
+  the desktop place for application settings on Windows and Linux. The
+  row has no ribbon cell (`ribbon: None`): the top band's Settings button
+  is the ribbon's entry, and a second cell for the same window would
+  only take space. No shortcut: no key is free by convention on all three
+  systems without a check of every key handler.
+- Appearance: the theme and the colour vision as two combo boxes. A pick
+  queues the same `SelectTheme` / `SelectColorVision` that the Theme door
+  queues. The theme row is named "Colour theme", because the ribbon's
+  Theme door already has the name "Theme". The Theme door stays as the
+  quick switch; it does not get a row that opens this section in this PR.
+- Graphics: the line width and the anti-aliasing, with the same `State`
+  setters as before (`select_line_width`, `select_antialias`, which
+  refuses a sample count that the device does not offer). They left the
+  Display menu.
+- The Display menu's group heading "Graphics" is now "View options". It
+  keeps the grid, the origin axes, the projection, the quality presets and
+  the shading switches: these are part of normal viewing (answer 3 on
+  #3025), and #4493 moves only the line width and the anti-aliasing.
+- Graphics device: read-only rows for the adapter and the backend, read
+  from the startup GPU line (`gpu::GpuInfo::log_line`), and the sample
+  counts that the device offers. Headless, both say "Not known". This
+  section has no "Reset to defaults": it holds no setting.
+- Updates: "Check for updates" as a `check_row`; off hides a shown update
+  notice, as the dropdown row did.
+- "Reset to defaults" uses the defaults of the file types
+  (`prefs::ViewPrefs::default()`, `LineWidth::default()`,
+  `Antialias::default()`, check for updates on).
+- The per-user file formats do not change, so an old `prefs.json` and
+  `view.json` load with the same values.
+
+**Dropped.**
+
+- A ribbon cell for Settings: the top band button is already there.
+- Moving the whole Display "Graphics" group: the grid, axes and
+  projection are quick viewing toggles.
+- A "Settings…" row in the Theme door: optional on #3025; it can come with
+  F2.
+- An MCP tool or a CLI flag: none now (answer 4 on #3025).
+
+**Cost to change later.** A new section is one `Section` variant, its
+label and one draw function. A menu move of the row is one field in
+`panes/table.rs`.
